children: Overview
U.S. hotel REIT's Q3 revenue fell 41% yr/yr due to hotel property sales
Same property RevPAR rose 11.7% and NOI grew 23.5% on improved market conditions
Company continues strategic review, expects more hotel sales to boost liquidity and cut debt
Outlook
Company expects to close sales of nine hotels for $137.3 mln in Q4 2026 and Q1 2027
Company plans to use proceeds from hotel sales to redeem Series C Shares and Debentures
AHIP continues strategic review, including potential further asset sales and other alternatives
Result Drivers
ASSET SALES - Revenue and NOI declines were primarily due to the sale of hotel properties in 2025 and 2026
SAME PROPERTY GROWTH - Co attributed higher same property RevPAR, ADR, and occupancy to improved market conditions and revenue management, especially from retail and government travel
OPERATING EXPENSES - Higher room labour, utilities, and maintenance expenses partially offset gains
